choose.when: AND MBRIntersects( ST_SRID( POLYGON(LINESTRING( POINT(#{condition.area.swLng}, #{condition.area.swLat}), POINT(#{condition.area.neLng}, #{condition.area.swLat}), POINT(#{condition.area.neLng}, #{condition.area.neLat}), POINT(#{condition.area.swLng}, #{condition.area.neLat}), POINT(#{condition.area.swLng}, #{condition.area.swLat}))), 4326), s.location) AND ST_Latitude(s.location) BETWEEN #{condition.area.swLat} AND #{condition.area.neLat} AND ST_Longitude(s.location) BETWEEN #{condition.area.swLng} AND #{condition.area.neLng}
choose.otherwise: AND MBRIntersects( ST_SRID( POLYGON(LINESTRING( POINT(#{condition.nearby.swLng}, #{condition.nearby.swLat}), POINT(#{condition.nearby.neLng}, #{condition.nearby.swLat}), POINT(#{condition.nearby.neLng}, #{condition.nearby.neLat}), POINT(#{condition.nearby.swLng}, #{condition.nearby.neLat}), POINT(#{condition.nearby.swLng}, #{condition.nearby.swLat}))), 4326), s.location) AND ST_Distance_Sphere( s.location, ST_SRID(POINT(#{condition.nearby.centerLng}, #{condition.nearby.centerLat}), 4326)) <= #{condition.nearby.radiusMeters}

mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS basecamp_id, b.start_date AS start_date, b.end_date AS end_date FROM basecamp b JOIN basecamp_member m ON m.basecamp_id = b.id WHERE m.member_id = #{viewerId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED'
SELECT s.id AS spot_id, s.name AS name, s.type AS type FROM spot s WHERE s.id = #{spotId}
